notes: 3-shaped signs read s unless ')'/'7'-shaped (m) or in the formula mẖe; mẖ?e in line 4 is written as two identical '7' shapes (copy shows mm), read mẖe from the benediction 'at mẖe' (Kar. 125, 128). p?siḫrkte: first sign is a long-tailed ξ/Ʒ, p or k (k by shape, p by the parallel psiḫrkte formula). 'aḫsḫo' in line 3: a, c-shaped sign (ḫ or to without dot), 3, a 6-shaped hooked sign (ḫ?), slash; may be a garbled ato mẖe. A single raised dot stands between p(4)ste and at (not a full divider), written as a space. '4ς' / '/4-' groups (a 4 or slash crossed by a bar plus a hook) read te throughout; could be i + l. ẑ / ϰ-like signs read d (could be ñ). In line 3 the groups ḫrslo / sk / se / qo are evenly spaced, written without spaces. si in line 7 is a ligature of 4 with three strokes and a 3 (maybe qi or yi). te? in line 11 is the sign marked sic (slash with a 4-like body; maybe y, giving yetmdelo). a? in line 10: ς and long-tailed 2 standing apart, the 2 marked sic. Line 15 starts after a clear gap with no divider. The divider after sdelo (line 17) is a single dot in the copy.
